day10.requirement: no gatherer with hunger or thirst >= 90 at any 120-tick sample

day120.requirement: no gatherer with hunger or thirst >= 90 at any 120-tick sample

deaths_dehydration_10.requirement: zero in every seed at day 10

deaths_starvation_10.requirement: zero in every seed at day 10

alive_band.requirement: alive in [32, 44] at every day sample from day 30

birth_by_day4.requirement: a birth by day 4 in every seed (10-day round)

old_age_by_day30.requirement: >= 1 old-age death by day 30 in every seed

one_settlement.requirement: one settlement at every day sample

replacement.requirement: births >= deaths - 3 over days 30..120 in every seed

stagnation.requirement: longest stagnant run <= 4 days in every seed

every_seed.requirement: each seed's store share from day 3 >= 0.40

store_share.requirement: store meals / all meals per seed-day from day 3, median >= 0.60

autumn_wood.requirement: autumn wood gathered per day median >= 1.5 x summer's (seed-days)

autumn_work.requirement: autumn adult work share at 12:00 median >= v11's autumn value - 0.05

trip_days.requirement: days with wood trips per winter (of 7), median over seed-winters >= 4

trips.requirement: wood trips per winter, median over seed-winters >= 20

other_lit.requirement: outside winter, 02:00 lit share: median >= 0.95, every seed >= 0.85

winter_lit.requirement: per seed share of winter nights lit at 02:00: median in [0.70, 0.97], every seed >= 0.50

winter_cold.requirement: winter cold members / members in the cold window: median <= 0.25, every seed <= 0.50

winter_food.requirement: food store at each winter's last periodic sample, median >= 0.8 x v11's

idle_1200.requirement: idle share of all residents at 12:00 median <= 0.60 (spring-autumn)
